Override. The judge deducts for not committing to a full search plan before the researcher confirms whether they have the identifier. But judge_context says 'asking the researcher for its identifier or collection is a legitimate first step and counts as following the lead.' The reply asks for the FamilySearch link or identifier and explicitly offers to plan a search in the Kentucky deaths and burials collection if the researcher lacks it. That is the first step judge_context sanctions. A committed Pulaski County search plan is not required on this turn before the researcher confirms whether they have the identifier.
